scope: Frozen amplitude directions projected from one/multi-cycle windows on a common supported center range. Origins are sampling/window sensitivity checks, not independent recordings. Known stationary OSC plus stationary Gaussian noise and detuned OSC impose no source AM; true single-carrier AM is a separate control. Central-bin noise gain differs across windows; results are not interchangeable power budgets or physical modulation measurements. No new fit/runtime model or promotion.
